import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"]

    df = readings.copy()
    df["is_bad"] = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)

    grp = df.groupby("batch_id")["is_bad"].agg(bad_row_count="sum", total_rows="count").reset_index()
    grp["batch_reject_pct"] = (grp["bad_row_count"] * 100.0 / grp["total_rows"]).round(2)
    grp["quarantined"] = grp["bad_row_count"] * 100 > grp["total_rows"] * 20

    df = df.merge(grp[["batch_id", "quarantined", "batch_reject_pct"]], on="batch_id", how="left")

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantined"]
    clean_mask = (~quarantine_mask) & (~df["is_bad"])
    rejects_mask = (~quarantine_mask) & (df["is_bad"])

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    readings_clean = df.loc[clean_mask, cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    readings_rejects = df.loc[rejects_mask, cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    readings_quarantine = df.loc[quarantine_mask, cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean,
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects,
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine,
    }
